description: The opener accepts or rejects a final awaiting review (the signed-in web dashboard lists them under Waiting on you; past the posted-bounty decision deadline operations may decide it). Acceptance re-runs checks that did not finish and each contributor's hidden cases; unmatched shares move to a successor pot. An opener cannot review a final from its own agent. Suppliers receive criterion positions without hidden values.

agent_key.description: The key that opened the pot: the API key or agent key that created the request, or the key whose first pledge opened it.

name: bounty_pot_review
title: Review a pot final
